votes.motion: Approve the May 13, 2025, work session meeting minutes and the November 25, 2025, formal meeting minutes.
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes from the May 13, 2025 work session and the November 25, 2025 formal meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Silos Park Public Infrastructure District and defer action to a future meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the required public hearing for the proposed Silos Park Public Infrastructure District at approximately 470 West 600 South and deferred any decision to a future meeting pending additional briefings and a resolution.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 2 of 2026, amending fees and fee information in the Salt Lake City Consolidated Fee Schedule related to certain fire line fees and implement the full FY26 fire line fee structure upon adoption, with the Department of Public Utilities crediting customers for the per-inch multiplier portion of fire line fees paid from July 1, 2026, through the date of adoption.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance correcting errors and omissions in the Consolidated Fee Schedule for Public Utilities, specifically adding the title 'Fire Lines' and description 'Per Inch' to a rate table, and directed that affected customers be credited for overpayments since July 1, 2026.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda, including setting public hearing dates for two zoning ordinances and approving board appointments and reappointments.
votes.description: The Council approved the full consent agenda, which included setting February 3, 2026 public hearing dates for a zoning map amendment at 265 East 100 South and a zoning administration text amendment, approving board appointments of Kandi Tesen and Mazhar Kathi to the Business Advisory Board, and reappointments of Scott Lyttle to the Business Advisory Board and Amanda Barth to the Mosquito Abatement District Board.
